timeline.label: Forging of the Trionfi
timeline.summary: Shining Ones create the 22 Major Arcana, embedding timeline-shaping power.

timeline.label: Alexandrian Library Fire
timeline.summary: Caesar's siege fire destroys scroll stacks; refugees spirit Thoth papyri north—the future 'Book of Thoth' nucleus. During Caesar's siege of Alexandria, dockside flames damage store-rooms of the Great Library; fleeing scholars carry crates that later seed the legendary Book of Thoth.

timeline.label: Cicero drafts De Gloria
timeline.summary: Composed at Tusculum; annotated copy ('Cicero Codex Borealis') will be hidden in Hyperborea Library and later drive Petrarch's quest.

timeline.label: Cicero's death
timeline.summary: Cicero's death triggers a timeline-A paradox.

timeline.label: Cicero Codex Borealis hidden
timeline.summary: Atticus (or another Ciceronian ally) smuggles the annotated De Gloria to the Hyperborea Library during the post-proscription chaos.

timeline.label: Consecration of the Ara Pacis
timeline.summary: Altar reliefs animate every Great Conjunction; next cycle reveals Hannibal breach timing.

timeline.label: Battle of the Teutoburg Forest
timeline.summary: Three legions (XVII-XIX) are wiped out by Arminius; their lost eagles become coveted relics in later centuries.

timeline.label: Eruption of Mount Vesuvius
timeline.summary: Pompeii and Herculaneum entombed in ash—later excavations in the story uncover a fresco resembling the Wheel of Fortune.

timeline.label: Hyperborea Library opens to Roman envoys
timeline.summary: Emperor Hadrian dispatches a secret delegation beyond the Arctic Circle; their sealed report hints at a city of ice-glass archives.

timeline.label: Constitutio Antoniniana
timeline.summary: Edict of Caracalla grants Roman citizenship to nearly all free men in the empire.

timeline.label: Second (unrecorded) Vesuvius breach
timeline.summary: A minor fissure releases a burst of chronotonic ash—later mined by alchemists to forge time-reactive inks for the Trionfi cards.

timeline.label: Vision at the Milvian Bridge
timeline.summary: On the eve of battle, Constantine adopts the Chi-Rho standard after a visionary sign, altering imperial religious policy.

timeline.label: Dante's exile
timeline.summary: Frees Dante to join the Zanetti Train as chronicler.

timeline.label: First Roger de Flor death
timeline.summary: Assassinated at Adrianople in timeline-A; establishes recurring death loops.

timeline.label: Petrarch drafts Trionfi deck
timeline.summary: At University of Bologna he sketches the first card prototypes.

timeline.label: Creation of Trionfi & first meeting with La Signora
timeline.summary: Inciting-incident cluster: Petrarch invents the Trionfi deck; Giovanna (La Signora del Gioco) enters his life; the cards' latent power flickers.

timeline.label: Zanetti Train manifests in Bologna
timeline.summary: Anachronistic locomotive sparks the adventure.

timeline.label: Boarding the Zanetti Train
timeline.summary: Rising-action beat: Petrarch departs Bologna with Dante and the Grand Catalan Company, stepping into the wider temporal conflict.

timeline.label: Recruitment of La Signora del Gioco
timeline.summary: Dante persuades Giovanna to bring Petrarch aboard.

timeline.label: Petrarch's first Fool activation
timeline.summary: Resets a minor paradox while departing for Pangea.

timeline.label: Midpoint—discovery of Cicero's lost manuscript
timeline.summary: Petrarch finds the annotated *De Gloria* (Cicero Codex) and realises the full stakes of Dagon's scheme.

timeline.label: Roger's third death stand
timeline.summary: Dies defending the train; Dante accepts fixed points in time.

timeline.label: Projected Crown Ritual deadline
timeline.summary: If protagonists fail, Dagon unleashes Hannibal's host, sealing Inferno gate.
